# OpenEye

> Open-source "Ollama for vision": a CLI-first perception engine (`openeye`) that pulls, runs and serves computer-vision models locally and turns camera frames into structured JSON (objects, depth, scene graphs, safety zones) for robots, VLA models and AI agents. There is also a hosted, pay-per-call inference API at https://openeye.sh/v1.

Key facts:

- Install the CLI: `pipx install openeye-sh` (Python 3.12+; extras such as `openeye-sh[yolo]`, `[depth]`, `[all]`, `[mcp]`). Commands: `openeye list | pull | run | bench | serve | watch`, plus `openeye fleet`, `openeye mlops`, `openeye govern`, `openeye agent`, `openeye api`. `openeye docs` prints the full CLI reference.
- Local models (registry `cli/openeye_ai/models.yaml`): `yolov8`, `yolo26`, `rfdetr`, `grounding-dino` (open-vocabulary detection), `depth-anything`, `sam2` (segmentation), `smolvla` (vision-language-action).
- `openeye serve <model>` starts a local FastAPI server on http://localhost:8000 with `POST /predict`, `GET /health`, a local `/v1/*` API, and WebSockets (`/ws`, `/ws/perception`, `/ws/agentic`, `/ws/vlm`). The openeye.sh dashboard can connect to it.
- Hosted API: base URL `https://openeye.sh/v1`, auth `Authorization: Bearer oe_...` (keys from Dashboard → Settings → API Keys). `POST /v1/detect` (YOLOv8, 1 credit), `POST /v1/describe` (vision-language model, 3 credits; not enabled yet, returns 503), `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/usage`. Depth is self-hosted only (hosted `/v1/depth` returns 501). Images: JPEG/PNG under 4 MB. Credits are bought in Dashboard → Settings → Credits.
- MCP server: `openeye-mcp` (stdio) exposes local CLI tools and hosted-API tools to MCP clients such as Claude Code and Claude Desktop.
- Fleet management: a self-hosted FastAPI control plane (`backend/`, port 8001, Postgres) plus the dashboard's fleet pages for devices, staged deployments, groups, maintenance windows, alerts and device commands.
- Source code: https://github.com/aw3-technology/openeye.sh (CLI is MIT-licensed; PyPI package `openeye-sh`).

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://openeye.sh/docs): Installation, CLI reference, models, hosted API, server, fleet and deployment guides.
- [Full reference for LLMs](https://openeye.sh/llms-full.txt): Hosted API, local server, CLI and MCP quick reference in one plain-text file.
- [Models](https://openeye.sh/models): Detection, depth, segmentation and vision-language models.
- [Architecture](https://openeye.sh/architecture): Perception pipeline, runtime and fleet control plane.
- [Pricing](https://openeye.sh/pricing): Open source (free), Cloud (pay per call with credits), Enterprise.
- [Changelog](https://openeye.sh/changelog): Release notes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://openeye.sh/): Product overview, CLI examples and demo.
- [Use Cases](https://openeye.sh/use-cases): Robotics, industrial safety, drones, home automation and agents.
- [Live Demo](https://openeye.sh/demo): Interactive perception demo in the browser.
- [Blog](https://openeye.sh/blog): Engineering notes on perception, safety, memory and streaming.
- [About](https://openeye.sh/about): Mission and team.
- [Community](https://openeye.sh/community): GitHub, Discord and contributing.
- [Dashboard](https://openeye.sh/dashboard): Sign in (email/password or 1Profile) to manage API keys, credits, history, fleet devices and observation memory.
